'''Gon Tiek''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> located within the [[Gon Tiek system/Legends|Gon Tiek system]], a part of the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="Western Reaches" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], an elite Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] unit, [[Battle on Gon Tiek|fought]] on Gon Tiek.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gon Tiek was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Gon Tiek [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the world Gon Tiek, within grid square L-19.<ref name="EAOC" />
